# Clearhold 0.1.4 — build 25
- Agreements, agreement templates and attorney documents in Word (.docx, .doc), OpenDocument (.odt) and Rich Text (.rtf) form now save from the app. Before, the app answered "Download failed". - The email draft of a claimant agreement (.eml) now saves too. - Each of those files is checked before it is kept, the same way PDFs and images already are.

# Clearhold 0.1.4 — build 24
- The window has no maximum size: it fills a large external display, goes full screen (View > Enter Full Screen, Control-Command-F) and remembers its size and place. - View > Zoom In, Zoom Out and Actual Size (Command =, Command -, Command 0) scale the page, and pinch to zoom works. Your zoom is kept between launches. - Save a copy now keeps scanned PNG and JPG documents. - Includes the November 4 workspace update: save case progress, one-step approval, documents that open in a browser tab, case archive and history, the county log, and Light, Dark or Match system appearance.

# Clearhold 0.1.4 — build 23
- Adds the Dashboard to the View menu. Shortcuts are now ⌘1 Today, ⌘2 Dashboard, ⌘3 Cases and ⌘4 Add leads. - Moves saved workspaces to desk.theclearhold.com automatically. - Recovers from a refused or expired sign-in inside the app instead of showing an error page. - Saves downloads and restores Back and Home navigation. - Keeps the Violet & Ink look from build 22.

# Clearhold 0.1.4 — build 22
- Introduces the Violet & Ink identity across native app chrome, icons, launch artwork, and widgets. - Refines light and dark appearances while preserving clear status colors and existing workflows. - Includes the matching violet workspace styling for coordinated server deployment.

# Clearhold 0.1.4 (build 21)
- Moves Clearhold to desk.theclearhold.com; sign in again once.

# Clearhold 0.1.4 (build 20)
- Move through your workspace with Back and Home in the Mac app. - Open publisher source links in your default browser. - Save PDF evidence from the workspace with the macOS Save dialog.

# Clearhold 0.1.4 (build 19)
- Opens the Clearhold cloud workspace over HTTPS, with no Tailscale connection required. - Moves the two previously shipped local and Office workspace addresses to the cloud address on first launch. Other custom addresses remain unchanged. - Explains incorrect sign-in details and expired sign-in pages inside the app, with a fresh sign-in button that does not replay a submitted password. Connection failures have a separate retry view. - Installs as **Clearhold.app** with the approved branding while retaining the existing app, widget and App Group identities. - Includes the desktop widget, optional alerts while the app is open, and the signed Sparkle update interface.
